dataset_name: VegHealth14: A Multi-Crop Leaf Disease Image Dataset of 14 Commonly Cultivated Vegetables in Bangladesh
description: Leaf images of 14 commonly cultivated vegetable crops covering healthy leaves and diseases or pest damage, organised as 53 class folders named Crop_Condition. Every original image has been resized to 224x224 pixels; no augmentation has been applied. The collection contains exact duplicate files within classes, which are flagged per image in this file.
preprocessing: Files renamed to sequential numbers per class folder (natural sort order of the original file names)
Resized directly to 224x224 with bilinear resampling (macOS sips); aspect ratio not preserved, no cropping or padding
Converted to RGB JPEG at quality 95; original PNG and WebP files converted to JPEG
Images smaller than 224x224 (150x150 and 128x128) were upscaled
notes: duplicate_of gives the lowest-numbered file in the same class with identical content; null means the image is the first (or only) copy
in_multiple_classes is true when an identical image also appears in a different class folder
md5 is computed on the 224x224 JPEG file
